desc: 暖阳皂感家务调，手压双驱动免手洗、涡轮脱水与可分桶的十屏叙事
leaf: 手压双驱动旋转拖把（带脱水桶免手洗圆头拖把）
name: 暖阳手压双驱动旋转拖把款

shots.intent: 首屏一眼抓住「不必再手碰脏布」这个核心动机，把整套拖把与脱水桶放进被下午阳光照亮的居家一角，靠真实比例和落地阴影建立可信度
shots.textZone: upper-right headline stack, one kicker chip above and one short sub-line beneath

shots.intent: 用四格日常摩擦把换用免手洗方案的动机问出来，只呈现动作与状态，不给任何测试结论或功效断言
shots.textZone: one headline above the grid plus one short question label under each cell

shots.intent: 同光同机位双联，把旧法的徒手下压与新法的一手按压并置，用可见动作差异替代参数说明
shots.textZone: short header across the top plus one caption chip per panel

shots.intent: 把看不见的脱水机制落到可见的孔篮与真实水行为上，让买家自己读出「甩得干」而不给任何转速数字
shots.textZone: one dot-leader label at the basket rim plus one short headline above

shots.intent: 把功能清单转成九个实心圆角图标宫格，同机位同尺排布，一次读完全部卖点入口
shots.textZone: one header line at the top, one short two-line label under each of the nine icons

shots.intent: 把轻便与不弯腰两句文案换成一个可信动作：人直立操作、圆头平贴地面滑进低矮家具底，尺度由家具自然锚定
shots.textZone: right-third headline block with one sub-line and two stacked spec placeholders

shots.intent: 一屏两格讲透桶：左格俯视读分离仓格，右格侧面读拱形提柄与拖行，把结构和使用一次交代
shots.textZone: one headline above the pair and one caption chip per panel

shots.intent: 两格掠射微距读金属管壁、锁紧关节与加厚提柄的真实做工，把耐用与握感落在可见零件而不是参数上
shots.textZone: vertical ladder of three empty rounded pill frames on the left, one headline above the pair

shots.intent: 90 度俯视把整套配置一次摊平，同一套色板下的可选组合与规格空位一并交代，替掉不可复用的原始参数表
shots.textZone: one header, four empty rounded spec rows with dot leaders, two option chips

shots.intent: 最后一屏用暖阳光与陶土朱收住整套叙事，一处行动按钮引导下单，不承诺任何优惠数字
shots.textZone: left closing line block plus one rounded button in the lower left

style.backgroundSystem: one material per screen: a warm soapstone-ivory plaster wall #F5EBDD meeting a sunlit honey-oak plank floor #D8B384 for hero, scene and closing screens; a soapstone wet zone with shallow real water, clear foam and soft tile for the two water and wringer screens; a plain ivory rounded card with generous corner radius and generous gutters for the feature matrix and variant screens, never a hairline grid and never a random or mixed environment
style.iconSystem: solid rounded duotone pictograms with filled bodies and one knocked-out highlight, seated inside clay-red #C4402C rounded-square chips with generous corner radius, plus numbered solid circles as step markers; generous gutters; never a thin single-weight line icon, never a hairline frame, never a 3D gloss icon, never a real brand mark
style.lightingSystem: hard warm afternoon side light entering from frame right at around 4300K to 4800K, bright window key with visible falloff, every cast shadow falling to the left and running long, warm bounce filling the shadow side, honest specular sparkle on the polished pole and honest refractive caustics on wet surfaces, never a flat grey studio wrap and never a cool clinical key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm sunlit housework-and-bath ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm soapstone ivory #F5EBDD, sunlit honey-oak floor #D8B384, warm graphite text #322823 and one clay-red accent #C4402C drawn from the product's own handle; warm colour temperature lit by hard afternoon side light entering from frame right at around 4300K to 4800K so every shadow falls to the left and runs long, with warm bounce on the shadow side and honest speculars on the polished pole and honest refraction on wet surfaces; one background material per screen, either a warm soapstone-ivory plaster wall against sunlit honey-oak floorboards, a soapstone wet zone with shallow real water and clear foam, or a plain ivory rounded card with generous corner radius and no hairline grid; modern geometric sans-serif with all in-image Chinese copy kept only inside 「」 and every colour stated as hex; solid rounded duotone pictograms with filled bodies inside clay-red #C4402C rounded-square chips plus numbered solid circles, never thin single-weight line icons; the round looped-yarn mop head on its polished circular base plate, the polished telescopic metal pole with its #C4402C grip collar and #2A2724 slide lock, and the #26221F bucket with its #C4402C arched carry handle and perforated #C4402C spin basket kept exactly as the reference and standing on true contact shadows; no invented mop-head size, bucket capacity in litres, spin rate or revolutions per minute, microfibre density, telescopic length, load rating, standard or certification number, no un-signposted wet floor hazard, no child handling the bucket, no bare hand in the water; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
